Rule

.`a full-height phone window gets the full preferred panel`()
Test
.`landscape takes its preferred height from values-land, not the portrait value`()
.`a split-screen pane never gives the panel more than half the window`()
.`a very short window still leaves the majority of the pane to the host app`()
.`landscape is clamped rather than using the portrait height`()
.`an extremely short window keeps the panel usable rather than collapsing it`()
.`the number row brings its own height instead of taking it from the letters`()
.`the panel keeps its shipped height when the number row is off`()
.`the height preference can shrink the panel`()
.`the height preference can grow the panel`()
.`raising the slider is not silently clamped away`()
.`a user who never touched the slider is unaffected by the raised ceiling`()
.`choosing a smaller keyboard does not tighten the clamp`()
